policy: Question definitions are public repository data. Candidate answers belong only in ignored local profile versions.

rules.setup_required: Only definitions marked setup_required are needed before an application-changing function starts.
rules.optional_profile: Optional reusable answers may be confirmed in advance but never block first launch.
rules.when_encountered: Ask only after an application presents the exact question and independent work is complete.
rules.required_only: Ask only when the portal requires an answer; salary is never assumed.
rules.application_specific: Do not reuse an answer across applications, even when wording looks similar.

questions.prompt: Have you previously worked for this employer?
questions.review_reason: A local default may be used only when there is no answer recorded for the named employer.

questions.prompt: Have you previously applied to this employer?
questions.review_reason: The answer depends on the named employer, programme and application cycle.

questions.prompt: Are you currently, or have you previously been, an employee, contractor or agency worker for this employer?
questions.review_reason: Worker categories and group-company scope differ by employer.

questions.prompt: Do you have a relative or close personal relationship with anyone working for this employer?
questions.review_reason: The answer is specific to the employer and the relationship definition shown.

questions.prompt: Were you referred by an employee of this employer?
questions.review_reason: Referral details belong only to the named application.

match_terms: how did you hear about us
questions.prompt: How did you hear about this opportunity?
questions.review_reason: Use the actual source for this vacancy and the portal's exact choices.

questions.prompt: Do you have a conflict of interest relevant to this employment?
questions.review_reason: Apply the employer's stated definition to the circumstances at the time of application.

questions.prompt: Do you have the legal right to work in the country of employment?
questions.review_reason: Resolve from confirmed country-specific permission, start date and portal wording.

questions.prompt: Will you now or in the future require immigration sponsorship for this role?
questions.review_reason: Resolve from country, permission type, expiry, programme length and the employer's wording.

match_terms: without requiring a visa or sponsorship
questions.prompt: Do you have the legal right to work for the full programme and later substantive role without requiring a visa or sponsorship?
questions.review_reason: The answer depends on country, start date, programme duration, immigration permission and employer wording.

questions.prompt: Will you meet the stated minimum age by the start date?
questions.review_reason: The threshold and relevant date must come from the exact vacancy question.

match_terms: valid and in date passport or national identity card
questions.prompt: Will you hold a valid passport or national identity card by the employment start date?
Are you available to work full time?
Are you willing to relocate for a role?
Are you willing to travel when a role requires it?
Can you meet a role's stated office or hybrid attendance requirement?
questions.review_reason: Confirm the exact location and number of required days before reuse.

questions.prompt: Are you willing to work the stated shifts, evenings or weekends?
questions.review_reason: The exact schedule still needs to match the vacancy.

questions.prompt: What is your current notice period?
What is your earliest available start date?
Do you hold a valid driving licence?
Do you have access to a vehicle when a role requires one?
Have you completed, or do you expect to complete, a degree?
What is your actual or expected graduation date?
What degree classification have you achieved or do you expect?
Do you meet the vacancy's stated minimum academic requirements?
questions.review_reason: Validate the named qualification, subject, grade, institution and date against confirmed education records.

questions.prompt: Do you hold the professional qualification required for this vacancy?
questions.review_reason: Match the exact qualification and current status requested by the vacancy.

questions.prompt: Which languages can you use professionally, and at what proficiency?
Have you ever been dismissed by an employer?
Have you been, or are you currently, the subject of a formal disciplinary investigation?
Are you subject to a restrictive covenant or non-compete that may affect this role?
Do you have any criminal conviction or matter that must be declared under this question?
questions.review_reason: Jurisdiction, spent-conviction rules, role exemptions and wording differ; never infer or reuse this declaration.

questions.prompt: Are you subject to any regulatory investigation or sanction covered by this question?
questions.review_reason: Use the regulator, jurisdiction, time period and scope stated by the employer.

questions.prompt: Have you been debarred or disqualified from work or a regulated activity covered by this question?
questions.review_reason: The scope depends on the named jurisdiction, regulator and activity.

questions.prompt: Do you have a non-discharged bankruptcy, IVA, or Scottish trust deed?
Do you have CCJs or defaults totalling over £10,000?

match_terms: four or more county court judgements or judgment debts
questions.prompt: Do you have four or more CCJs or judgment debts?
Will any outside business interest or other role continue after you start this employment?
Are you a director or officer of a company or other organisation?
Are you, or a person connected to you, within the definition of a politically exposed person shown here?
questions.review_reason: Use the portal's definition, covered relationships, jurisdiction and time period.

questions.prompt: Can you provide the references requested for employment?
questions.review_reason: Reference contact details are requested only when the application requires them.

questions.prompt: May this employer contact your current employer for a reference at the stated stage?
questions.review_reason: This permission is employer-specific and may depend on the recruitment stage.

questions.prompt: Do you agree to continue with the employer's stated pre-employment vetting checks?
questions.review_reason: This is consent to the named employer's notice and must be confirmed for that application.

questions.prompt: Do you consent to the background or security checks described for this role?
questions.review_reason: Confirm only after the named checks and privacy notice are shown.

questions.prompt: What current security clearance do you hold, if any?
What salary do you expect for this role?
questions.review_reason: Ask only when the portal requires an answer. Never infer a figure from profile history or another role.

questions.prompt: What current compensation information does this application require?
questions.review_reason: Ask only if required and preserve the currency, period and components in the exact wording.

questions.prompt: Do you want to request a reasonable adjustment for this recruitment process?
questions.review_reason: Needs and processes can differ by assessment and application; never infer an answer.

questions.prompt: How do you want to answer this voluntary disability disclosure?
questions.review_reason: Use the portal's exact definition and choices; never infer from other information.

questions.prompt: How do you want to answer this voluntary gender identity disclosure?
questions.review_reason: Use the portal's exact choices; never infer from title, name or documents.

questions.prompt: How do you want to answer this voluntary ethnicity disclosure?
questions.review_reason: Categories vary by jurisdiction and employer; never infer from nationality, name or documents.

questions.prompt: How do you want to answer this voluntary sexual orientation disclosure?
questions.review_reason: This is sensitive voluntary information and is never inferred or reused automatically.

questions.prompt: How do you want to answer this voluntary religion or belief disclosure?
questions.review_reason: This is sensitive voluntary information and is never inferred or reused automatically.

questions.prompt: How do you want to answer this voluntary veteran status disclosure?
questions.review_reason: Definitions differ by jurisdiction; use only the portal's exact choices.

match_terms: occupation of your main household earner
questions.prompt: What was the occupation category of your main household earner when you were about 14?
choices: Modern professional and traditional professional occupations
Senior, middle or junior managers or administrators
Routine, semi-routine manual and service occupations
Small business owners who employed fewer than 20 people

questions.prompt: Are you the first generation in your family to attend university?
questions.review_reason: Confirm the definition used by the application before reuse.

questions.prompt: Did either parent or guardian complete a university degree?
questions.review_reason: Confirm the relationship and qualification definition shown by the application.

questions.prompt: Were you eligible for free school meals during the period stated?
questions.review_reason: The school years and jurisdiction in the exact question must match.

questions.prompt: What type of school did you mainly attend between ages 11 and 16?
choices: Independent or fee-paying school with a bursary
School outside the country of application

questions.prompt: How do you want to answer this voluntary care-experience question?
questions.review_reason: Definitions and periods differ, and this sensitive answer is never inferred.

questions.prompt: Do you acknowledge the privacy notice shown for this application?
questions.review_reason: The user must be shown the named notice before acknowledging it.

questions.prompt: Do you declare that the information in this application is true and accurate?
questions.review_reason: This declaration applies to the completed application and requires final user review.

questions.prompt: Enter the electronic signature requested for this application.
questions.review_reason: A signature is never filled as an ordinary name field and requires explicit user action.

questions.prompt: Do you agree to the terms and conditions shown for this application?
questions.review_reason: Terms must be reviewed for the specific application before acceptance.

questions.prompt: Do you want to receive optional marketing communications?
questions.review_reason: Optional marketing consent is never inferred from application consent.

questions.prompt: Do you consent to being considered for future opportunities or a talent pool?
questions.review_reason: This optional use of application data needs a separate employer-specific choice.

questions.prompt: Do you consent to the recorded or automated assessment process described here?
questions.review_reason: Present the provider, recording, automated-processing and retention terms before asking.
